cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. They'll worry about Mr Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then everyone says, 'Mr Patel is fine; the bus needs repairs.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

mechanism: A copy-edits a repeatable school-trip statement that reassures about the driver while adding only the factual qualifier B shows is needed.
confusable: D181 hides A's own role; D183 protects another person or group with a simple safe-to-repeat account.
comparison: Office-parent-child consistency differs from protecting Grandad during his speech.
seedUse: Keep parked-bus fact and parent question; the expert correction should edit the live sentence rather than add a stock lecture.
